title: Extension.
officialText:
The commissioner may grant an extension of time of up to 90 days from the date of the
application for an extension to complete the repairs required to correct an unsafe condition upon receipt and
review of an initial extension application submitted by the registered design professional together with such
additional documentation as may be prescribed by rule.
